grammar.title: have (got) 表示疾病
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has (got) + a + 疾病名词
grammar.definition: 英语中表示患病常用 have (got) + 疾病名词。a cold, a headache 等疾病前常用不定冠词 a/an；measles, mumps 等复数形式疾病名前不用冠词；flu 等不可数疾病名前也不用冠词。
grammar.usage: He has a bad cold. / She has a headache. / Most children are in bed with mumps.

examples.en: He has a bad cold, Mr Williams.
examples.zh: 他得了重感冒，威廉斯先生。

grammar.title: must 表示必要性与义务
grammar.structure: 主语 + must/mustn't + 动词原形
grammar.definition: must 表示「必须、一定」，是情态助动词，无人称、时态变化，后接动词原形。mustn't（must not）表示「禁止、不允许」。用于医嘱、规矩等。
grammar.usage: We must call the doctor. / He mustn't go to school yet.

examples.en: He must stay in bed for a week.

title: A bad cold / What's the matter with ...?
subtitle: 重感冒 / ……怎么了？

lead.question: 孩子躺在床上说不舒服，你打电话请医生、报出电话号码——怎样用 feel/look 描述症状，用 must 表达「必须卧床」，用 have a bad cold 说病情？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象吉米病了：他自我感觉不舒服（feel ill），旁人看他气色差（look ill）。父母得请医生，还得报出医生电话。诊断后医生说「重感冒，必须卧床一周」——对孩子来说这反而是好消息，因为他不爱上学。听录音时留意 feel/look 这两个系动词后接形容词，以及 must 表「必须」、have a bad cold 表疾病。
goals: 能用 What's the matter with ...? 询问病情
理解 feel ill（自我感觉）与 look ill（外表）的区别，二者都是系动词 + 形容词
能用 have a bad cold 等 have (got) + 疾病 表示患病
能用 must + 动词原形 表达必要性（mustn't 表禁止）
理解 news 是不可数名词（以 -s 结尾却是单数）
lead.summary: 第 61 课威廉斯夫妇发现吉米病了，请医生来，医生检查后说他得了重感冒，必须卧床一周；威廉斯夫人说这对吉米是好消息，因为他不喜欢上学。全课用 feel/look 描述症状、用 must 表医嘱、用 have a bad cold 说病情。第 62 课用 What's the matter with ...? / Does he/she have a ...? 轮换各种病痛与对策。
lead.tips: ① feel/look 是系动词，后接形容词（ill），像 be 一样；② have a bad cold 中 a 不可省（疾病前常用不定冠词）；③ must 表必须，无时态人称变化，mustn't 表禁止；④ for a week 中 for 引出一段时间；⑤ news 以 -s 结尾但不可数，不能说 a news；⑥ because 与 so 不并用。

questions.a: That he must stay in bed for a week, because he doesn't like school.

questions.hint: 听 That's good news for Jimmy. / Because he doesn't like school!

questions.q: What does the doctor tell Jimmy to do?
questions.a: He must stay in bed for a week.
questions.hint: He has a bad cold, so he must stay in bed for a week.

questions.q: What is the doctor's telephone number?
questions.zh: 医生的电话号码是多少？

questions.q: Why are both 'feel ill' and 'look ill' used? Are they the same?
questions.zh: 为什么同时用了 feel ill 和 look ill？两者一样吗？
questions.a: No. feel ill is how Jimmy feels inside (subjective); look ill is how he appears to others (objective). Both feel and look are link verbs followed by an adjective.
questions.aZh: 不一样。feel ill 是吉米的自我感觉（主观），look ill 是旁人看他的样子（客观）。两者都是系动词，后接形容词。
questions.hint: feel/look 都是系动词，像 be 一样后接形容词。

questions.q: What's the matter with Elizabeth? Does she have an earache? No, she doesn't have an earache. She has a headache. So she must take an aspirin.
questions.zh: 第 62 课操练：用 What's the matter with ...? / Does he/she have a ...? 轮换病痛与对策。
questions.a: What's the matter with George? Does he have a headache? No, he doesn't have a headache. He has an earache. So he must see a doctor.
questions.aZh: 乔治怎么了？他头疼吗？不，他耳朵疼。所以他得看医生。
questions.hint: 用 have (got) a + 病痛，must 接对策。
